What you will do Melotech is scaling fast, and paid acquisition is one of the engines behind it. As Growth Manager, you own that engine end to end: the budget, the channels, the creative testing and the numbers behind them. This is a paid acquisition role first, measured on what every unit of spend brings back. You decide where the budget goes across a large portfolio of releases and campaigns, in a business where small improvements compound, and you work directly with our founders, product and data team. Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now. Our customers include category-defining companies like Lovable https://modal.com/blog/lovable-case-study, Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale. We recently raised a $355M Series C https://modal.com/blog/modal-series-c at a $4.65B valuation, led by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures. We've crossed $300M+ ARR and grown fivefold since September. Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g., Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn, Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders ABOUT THE ROLE We're hiring the first Account Managers at Modal. jobs.title: Research Intern
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE As a Research Intern at NeoCognition, you'll explore novel ideas and work on longer-term research bets that push the boundaries of LLM agents. This internship is designed for those who want to dive deep into open research problems — from reasoning and planning to multi-agent coordination and evaluation. You'll have the freedom to pursue high-risk, high-reward directions that may not be tied to immediate product needs, but could shape the future of agentic AI systems. Your work will culminate in research prototypes and, ideally, publications that contribute to the broader AI research community. You'll collaborate closely with our research scientists and engineers, receiving mentorship and feedback as you design experiments, build prototypes, and analyze results. RESPONSIBILITIES - Explore novel research directions in areas such as LLM reasoning, planning, tool use, multi-agent systems, or evaluation methodologies. - Design and execute exploratory experiments to test new hypotheses and push the boundaries of what agentic systems can do. - Build research prototypes that demonstrate new capabilities or insights, even if they are not immediately production-ready. - Collaborate with the research team to document findings, analyze results, and iterate on ideas. - Work toward publishing research outcomes in top-tier AI venues (NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, etc.) or contributing to open-source efforts. - Participate in team discussions, paper readings, and brainstorming ses

jobs.title: General Application / Future Openings
jobs.description_text: As civilization electrifies, energy demand will continue to outpace the deployment of terrestrial infrastructure required to deliver it. Space solar energy has the potential to decouple energy generation from geography, weather, and traditional transmission constraints, creating an entirely new layer of global energy infrastructure. Overview Energy is building that new layer: satellites that redirect solar energy from geosynchronous orbit to existing terrestrial solar projects using passively safe near-infrared light. jobs.title: Research Scientist
jobs.description_text: Pluralis Research works on Protocol Learning: training and serving large models in a fully decentralized way on small consumer-grade devices connected via the internet. Despite being dismissed as infeasible, we have made significant advances on this problem, most recently Agora, a permissionless run that pretrained an 8B model from scratch on consumer GPUs spread over the internet, with no single participant ever holding the full weights (tech report https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.13332). While many of the core research problems have been solved, Protocol Learning unlocks a series of new challenges. For the mission in full, read A Third Path: Protocol Learning https://pluralis.ai/blog/a-third-path-protocol-learning/. This setting breaks nearly every assumption of datacenter training and inference: communication-efficient training across different parallelism axes, fault tolerance as nodes join and drop mid-run, heterogeneous compute and networks, and robustness to malicious participants. Our published methods include Subspace Networks https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.01260, Factored Gossip DiLoCo https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22768, AsyncMesh https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22442, and Sentinel https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03592. As a Research Scientist you work on the problems that stay open as we push from the 8B run toward frontier scale, and you publish what you find. These are foundational papers up for grabs. This role is ideal for technical, consultative professionals who have led complex software implementations and can move comfortably between customer discovery, solution design, hands-on delivery, and executive communication. About the role Perplexity Computer is a new class of AI system that navigates tools, interacts with applications, and completes multi-step workflows end to end. Our customers are using Computer to transform work that traditional software has not been able to address. Applied AI Architects work directly with customers across presales, onboarding, adoption, and strategic engagements. You will uncover the real business problem, determine what Computer can credibly support, design and configure the workflow, and lead the engagement to a clear outcome. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role at the intersection of solutions architecture, technical consulting, and program delivery. You will work closely with Sales and Customer Success while serving as a quality filter for requests that require Product or Engineering. What you'll do - Lead technical discovery. Work with customer business leaders, technical teams, account executives, and customer success managers to understand the users, current workflow, desired outcome, constraints, and decision-makers. - Design credible solutions. jobs.title: Public Policy Associate
jobs.description_text: ABOUT PERPLEXITY Perplexity is AI for people who expect more. More accuracy. More agency. More signal, less noise. Our answer engine handles hundreds of millions of queries every month for people whose questions spark change and whose decisions bend the world toward progress. As our footprint grows, so does the number of policymakers, agencies, and civil society leaders who want to understand what we are building and how we think. ABOUT THE ROLE We're hiring a Public Policy Associate in Washington, D.C. to sit at the center of Perplexity's engagement with Congress, the executive branch, trade associations, think tanks, and the broader D.C. ecosystem. This work happens where Washington happens, in Hill offices, in coalition meetings across town, and at the occasional evening event where the conversations that matter most actually take place. This is a relationship heavy, execution heavy seat. You've already worked both sides of the table, once inside a congressional office and once representing an organization before Congress, and you know how policy actually moves. Our Comms team and executive leadership set the strategy; you're our boots on the ground who makes it real. You'll build the stakeholder map, carry our message into the rooms that matter, and bring back what policymakers are saying, so that Perplexity shows up early, credibly, and consistently on the policy questions shaping AI. This role reports to the Senior Director, Product, Privacy & Regulatory Legal. WHAT YOU

jobs.title: Director, Litigation
jobs.description_text: Perplexity AI is looking for a sharp, entrepreneurial litigation attorney to join our small legal team to help advance the business, protect the products we are building, and revolutionize the way people search and interact with the internet. This unique role offers significant responsibility, direct ownership of high stakes matters, and growth potential across an in-house practice group. This is a unique role within a rapidly growing AI technology company. You will play a key role in safeguarding Perplexity’s interests by managing litigation files and pre-litigation disputes related to our AI answer engine, models, and technologies, while helping to build and scale our litigation function. You will oversee complex disputes in a fast-moving and often unsettled legal landscape, spanning intellectual property (including copyright), privacy, commercial, and regulatory matters, and you will work closely with our AI, engineering, and product teams to assess legal risk, develop litigation strategy, and provide guidance during disputes involving our products and services. The ideal candidate combines deep substantive knowledge of litigation practice and procedure with strong business judgment and practical problem-solving abilities. You are comfortable confronting novel legal issues, including questions where the rules are still being written, and you bring intellectual curiosity about AI technology, adaptability in an emerging landscape, and exceptional collaboration skills. jobs.title: Strategic Finance Lead - Compute
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a Strategic Finance Lead for our GPU compute fleet. In this role, you will be a key partner to our inference and infrastructure teams, providing financial expertise to optimize our compute investments and drive capacity decisions. In this role, you'll develop deep expertise in the economics of AI compute, from token-level serving cost to the long-range financial planning of our GPU fleet. You'll build the models that inform Perplexity's capacity and make-versus-buy decisions, own the internal-cost analysis that underpins internal and external token pricing, and translate complex infrastructure dynamics into clear financial narratives for leadership. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives at the intersection of finance and infrastructure, and who is energized by building frameworks from scratch in a fast-moving environment. This position is based in San Francisco and requires in-person attendance 2-3 days per week. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Finance lead for GPU compute spend, including budgeting, monthly forecasting, variance analysis, and financial plan maintenance - Build and maintain detailed bottoms-up financial models for the GPU fleet, including capacity forecasts, cost driver analyses, and investment scenario modeling - Develop deep expertise in GPU vendor contracts, pricing structures, and cost drivers, and surface optimization opportunities across the fleet - Serve as subject matter expert for Perplexity's compute capacity plan,

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (TPM, Inference)
jobs.description_text: Perplexity is looking for a technical program manager to be the connective tissue between our model providers, engineering, and product teams, driving our core inference platform forward. Perplexity runs one of the highest-throughput inference stacks in the industry, serving Ask, Computer, and API traffic across a large and constantly shifting portfolio of first-party and third-party models. This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, and finance: you'll orchestrate across model providers and internal teams to keep new models and capacity moving smoothly into production, while executing the roadmap for the inference platform itself. The ideal candidate has strong technical judgment, thrives coordinating across teams and external partners with competing timelines, and is energized by building the operating model for a function that doesn't have much precedent yet. jobs.description_text: Perplexity's API Platform brings our work in AI, search, and agent orchestration to developers. Our customers range from AI-native startups to some of the world's largest technology companies. Working with them, alongside our own developments in building Perplexity’s core application gives our team direct exposure to how search, models, and tools are used to build and scale AI-native products and applications. The role is roughly half customer-facing and half strategic and operational work, with an initial focus on building and improving our post-sale programs. You will own a portfolio of API customers, learning how AI-native companies and large enterprises evaluate, adopt, and scale AI infrastructure. Working closely with API leadership, you will help shape how the business operates and lead projects such as product migrations, customer enablement, and account coverage. You will put recommendations into practice, with results measured in customer adoption, retention, and growth. RESPONSIBILITIES - Manage a portfolio of API customer relationships, leading account conversations, understanding business priorities, and coordinating next steps across technical and commercial teams. - Build account plans around adoption, value, and growth. Identify risks early and partner with Sales and account owners on renewals and expansion.

jobs.description_text: Perplexity is hiring an experienced Communications & Marketing Recruiter to help build the teams responsible for how our company and products are positioned, launched, explained, and experienced. jobs.title: Perplexity Research Fellowship
jobs.description_text: Welcome to the application portal for the Perplexity Research Fellowship! The Perplexity Research Fellowship is our flagship program for enabling the best early-career STEM talent to shape the future of frontier intelligence. - Please refer to the program homepage https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/research/fellowship for full details on the Perplexity Research Fellowship and application process. - When you're ready to apply, please complete and submit the application form. Make sure to carefully follow all instructions. - We'll evaluate applications on a rolling basis, with priority consideration for submissions received by September 30, 2026. - You should write your application without assistance from other humans or AI models. Submitting writing from other humans or AI models as your own will result in permanent disqualification from employment at Perplexity. - Please note that the Perplexity Research Fellowship is not an internship program for students seeking research experience between school terms. If you're currently a student and your requested Fellowship start date is before your graduation date, we will request verified proof of an approved leave of absence of 1 year or greater from your university as a precondition to any Fellowship offer.

You will set the strategy, develop the team, and build an org that is adaptable to keep pace with the company quickly evolving. We are looking for someone who brings original ideas, moves rapidly from insight to execution, and knows when to scale, adapt, or stop an approach. jobs.title: Sr. Workplace Coordinator
jobs.description_text: The Workplace team powers and connects the workday for all Perplexity employees across our global offices. We are hospitality and experience-driven at the core. We are made up of People people, meaning that we love supporting each other and all of the People in our workplace. We take on the good and the bad with optimism and with a positive, kind approach to solving problems, dealing with the obstacles handed to us, and proactively creating good around us. We think about each moment through the lens of our colleagues (our customers) so that we can create thoughtful and memorable experiences no matter what task we have at hand. Our New York City office of approximately 100 seats is located in Union Square. jobs.title: Computational Chemist
jobs.description_text: ABOUT PROXIMA Proxima (formerly VantAI) is advancing an AI-native approach to drug discovery by making protein interactions programmable. Our platform brings together foundation-model machine learning, a scalable data generation engine, and a partnership track record exceeding $5B in collaborations across the world’s leading biopharma and tech organizations. We’ve recently closed an oversubscribed seed round partnering us with an elite group of sophisticated and dedicated VCs including DCVC, Nvidia’s Nventures, AIX, Yosemite among others. Neo-1 is our all-atom foundation model that combines state-of-the-art structure prediction and molecular generation in a single system. Neo-1 enables rapid exploration of chemical and structural space for high value, previously intractable targets, and in particular unlocks small molecule proximity therapeutics like molecular glues with AI for the first time. In parallel, we are developing an advanced structural interactomics platform built on proprietary XLMS technology and a lab equipped with next-generation mass spectrometry instrumentation. This platform produces proteome-scale maps of protein interactions and helps identify small molecules that modulate proximity. Together with Neo-1, it creates an integrated system capable of co-folding protein complexes while generating candidate small molecules to influence those interactions. Proximity-based therapeutics represent one of most promising frontiers in modern drug discovery with the pot

Build evaluations for complex, long-horizon tasks and measure both frontier models and our own against them — so we know what's working and where to push next. jobs.title: Research Intern
jobs.description_text: We're hiring a Research Intern to help us answer a question no one has answered yet: how do you train a model that is genuinely good at research? This is hard, and largely uncharted. Very few groups have managed to teach LLMs to perform the open-ended, long-horizon reasoning that real research demands: forming a hypothesis, designing an experiment, reading the result, and deciding what to try next. We're doing it with a small team and a strong prior that research data can be used in a highly efficient and ingenious way. As a Research Intern, you'll own a real research question rather than a ticket. Depending on your interests, that might mean turning a corpus of arXiv papers into reinforcement learning environments, designing reward signals for ambiguous, long-horizon research tasks, building tight RL loops between user data and model training, or constructing research-focused benchmarks. jobs.title: Intern
jobs.description_text: About Ramiel Capital Ramiel Capital operates at the cutting edge of digital asset markets. As a premier cryptocurrency family office, we fuse elite quantitative research with the fast-paced world of on-chain trading. We recruit individuals with a hunger to try new products and who derive alpha from a deep understanding of crypto and financial market structure. Our culture is defined by rigorous intellectual curiosity and rapid execution. We demand audacity, transparency, and a competitive drive through this 11 week program, but we believe true alpha is generated through collective intelligence. At Ramiel, we don't just chase risk-adjusted returns; we specialize in unique, special-situation discretionary trading using alpha generated from a fundamental understanding of market mechanics. We believe markets function like a pop quiz: if you've studied and know the answers, the test is easy. This role includes a discretionary bonus derived from individual PnL generated. You will have the opportunity to manage capital. The Opportunity Are you driven by the volatility and complexity of decentralized markets? Do you thrive in high-pressure environments where technology meets liquidity? Are you ready to step onto a trading desk where you are expected to perform from Day One? We are seeking a dedicated Trading Intern to join our desk in New York. This is not a passive role; you will serve as a critical node in Ramiel’s operations, collaborating directly with researchers and engineers.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
jobs.description_text: Job Title: Executive / Personal Assistant to the Principal Organization: Private Family Office Location: NYC About the Role We are seeking a highly resourceful, discreet, and deeply organized Executive Assistant to support the Principal of a private family office. The Principal is the CEO of a rapidly scaling trading firm and trading technology firm (Ramiel.Capital / Fullstack.Trade http://Fullstack.Trade) and requires an EA who can seamlessly bridge the gap between high-level corporate operations and complex personal lifestyle management. The ideal candidate anticipates needs before they arise, operates with a high degree of autonomy, and is well-versed in supporting ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) individuals. Candidate ideally should have a social and culturally compatible background (modeling, hospitality etc.). based in New York. Core Responsibilities 1. jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE TEAM The Safety Systems team https://openai.com/safety/safety-systems is responsible for various safety work to ensure our best models can be safely deployed to the real world to benefit the society and is at the forefront of OpenAI's mission to build and deploy safe AGI, driving our commitment to AI safety and fostering a culture of trust and transparency. The Model Safety Research team aims to fundamentally advance our capabilities for precisely implementing robust, safe behavior in AI models, and to leverage these advances to make OpenAI’s deployed models safe and beneficial. This requires a breadth of new ML research to address the growing set of safety challenges as AI becomes more powerful and used in more settings. Key focus areas include how to enforce nuanced safety policies without trading off helpfulness and capabilities, how to make the model robust to adversaries, how to address privacy and security risks, and how to make the model trustworthy in safety-critical domains. jobs.title: Researcher, Training
jobs.description_text: About the Team OpenAI's Training team is responsible for producing the large language models that power our research, our products, and ultimately bring us closer to AGI. Achieving this goal requires combining deep research into improving our current architecture, datasets and optimization techniques, alongside long-term bets aimed at improving the efficiency and capability of future generations of models. We are responsible for integrating these techniques and producing model artifacts used by the rest of the company, and ensuring that these models are world-class in every respect. Recent examples of artifacts with major contributions from our team include GPT4-Turbo, GPT-4o and o1-mini.
